name: Joe and Madison's Blueberries
tagline: Link to Joe and Madison's Blueberries Facebook Page at https://www.facebook.com/Joe
description: Joe and Madison's Blueberries is a working farm in 271 Eldridge Drive, MS. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, with seasonal availability through spring, summer, autumn, and winter. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Mar – Jun in this growing zone.
